facts.text: The North Star Promise (NSP) Scholarship program creates a tuition-free pathway at Minnesota State Moorhead for eligible Minnesota residents with a combined household Adjusted Gross Income (AGI) of less than $80,000.

sources.title: The North Star Promise Scholarship Program
sources.quote: The North Star Promise (NSP) Scholarship program creates a tuition free pathway to higher education for eligible Minnesota residents at Minnesota State Moorhead.

sources.title: The North Star Promise Scholarship Program
sources.quote: Have a combined household Adjusted Gross Income (AGI) of less than $80,000. This includes both Student AGI and Parent AGI as reported on the FAFSA or MN Dream Act Application.

facts.text: Effective January 1, 2025, the Metro College Alliance course exchange agreement replaced the Tri-College University consortium, allowing students to take two courses per semester at a host campus while taking at least one course from their home campus.

sources.title: Metro College Alliance Registration Information at MSU Moorhead
sources.quote: Effective January 1, 2025, a new Metro College Alliance course exchange agreement will serve students in place of the Tri-College University consortium, which sunsets at the end of 2024.

sources.title: Metro College Alliance Registration Information at MSU Moorhead
sources.quote: The Metro College Alliance course exchange program allows students to take two courses per semester at a host campus while taking at least one course from their home campus.
